items.title: Starry Night Motion Blur Portrait
items.prompt: Preserve the face from the source photo: features, proportions, natural asymmetry, hair colour, skin tone. Face is softened by strong motion blur and out-of-focus blur at the same time, but the silhouette and features match the source. Ignore everything else from the source photo: background, clothing, pose, angle, lighting, composition. Night in a remote location far from city lights. The sky fills most of the frame — a dense scatter of stars, the glowing band of the Milky Way clearly visible running diagonally across the sky, a faint haze of nebulae. A dark horizon below, distant hill silhouettes barely visible. She stands facing the camera. The moment: a sudden gust of wind hits her — her body sways slightly, her head turns, the motion not yet settled. Her face is blurry for two combined reasons: the camera missed focus on her (out-of-focus blur) AND she moved during the shot (motion blur from the sudden gust). Both effects stack together — her face is soft, unfocused, and streaked in the direction of the movement. Facial contours double, features softened and generalized, no single point sharp. Still, the head silhouette and overall expression are guessable, the face stays recognizable by general shape, the features remain correct and attractive. Hair flew apart into long powerful blurred trails from the wind. Her face is lit by a soft warm light from below and in front — like a flashlight or small ground-level source — this light picks her out of the darkness, while the sky behind her stays completely dark and starry, not overexposed. Expression: a warm live smile, lips parted, corners raised — readable through the blur. Not a serious face. Clothing: {argument name="outfit" default="a long flowing slip dress in deep emerald silk"}, thin straps, the hem catching the wind and blurred by the motion, the dark fabric dissolving into the night. Hair: braided into a loose low braid over one shoulder, loose strands flying from the wind. Skin: the warm underlight creates soft upward shadows, detailed texture where untouched by the blur. Colour grading: {argument name="color aesthetic" default="Fujifilm Pacific Blues"} aesthetic — deep saturated blue tones in the sky and Milky Way, a warm contrasting accent from the underlight. items.title: Music Curation: Audio-Visual Dioramas for Pink Floyd Fans
items.prompt: Do this for {argument name="input band" default="Pink Floyd"}: Input Variable: [INSERT BAND/ALBUM] (e.g., Pink Floyd, Daft Punk, Nirvana) System Instruction: Act as a Music Historian and Set Designer. Create a 2x2 Grid of "Audio-Visual Dioramas." 1. The Curation Logic (The Deep Cuts): Analyze Input: Identify the genre and sonic signature of the Input Band. Select 4 Hidden Gems: Identify 4 lesser-known albums from other bands that share this sonic DNA but offer a different visual flavor. The Translation: For each album, define the "Sonic Materiality": If Heavy Metal: Rusty Iron, Fire, Spikes. If Synth-Pop: Neon Glass, Chrome, Laser Grids. If Folk/Acoustic: Mossy Wood, Stone, Candlelight. If Prog Rock: Surreal Marble, Floating Prisms, Clouds. 2. The "Immutable" Container (The Vinyl Stage): The Base: Each diorama is built on top of a Spinning Vinyl Record acting as the circular stage floor. The Plinth: The record sits on a high-end, thick Audiophile Turntable Base (Wood or Brushed Aluminum). The Nameplate (CRITICAL TEXT FIX): On the vertical front face of the Plinth, there is a Polished Brass or Digital Display Plate. Text Rule: It must clearly display the [ARTIST NAME] in bold, legible, capital letters. 3. The Composition (The Sound Made Solid): CRITICAL: Do not just recreate the album cover. Build a world that feels like the music. The Structure: Architecture rises from the grooves of the vinyl record. Example: A wall of amplifiers, a surreal floating prism, a crumbling brick wall, or a forest of microphone stands. The Atmosphere: Use particle effects to visualize the sound waves. Visuals: Floating musical notes made of smoke, vibrating liquid surfaces, or shattered glass suspended in mid-air. The Figures: Tiny 1:87 scale band members performing inside this surreal landscape. 4. Visual Syntax (Per Panel): Panel A: Album 1 (Focus on Surrealism/Scale). Panel B: Album 2 (Focus on Technology/Machinery). Panel C: Album 3 (Focus on Nature/Organic Textures). Panel D: Album 4 (Focus on Light/Color). 5. Lighting & Atmosphere: Concert Lighting: Each box is lit like a stage show. Spotlights, laser beams, and stage haze. Depth: Shallow depth of field (Tilt-Shift) to make the vinyl record look massive. Background: Seamless Slate Grey to keep the focus on the colors. Output: 2x2 Grid, Hyper-Realistic Miniature Set Design, 8k Resolution, "Audiophile" Aesthetic.

items.title: Man on Luxury Yacht Staircase
items.prompt: A confident adult {argument name="subject" default="male"} stands at the center-right of the frame, facing the camera with shifted weight and level shoulders. He features a neatly trimmed dark beard with natural density variations and short, stylish brown hair. He wears an unbuttoned white linen shirt, light beige trousers, and matching suede loafers. A subtle, closed smile graces his face as his left hand is raised, with the index finger and thumb lightly gripping the frame of his dark sunglasses, his fingers curling naturally. His right hand rests relaxed inside his front right trouser pocket with the thumb visibly exposed. He is positioned in the foreground on a pristine {argument name="setting" default="luxury yacht staircase"}, featuring warm brown teak wood treads detailed with black striped rubber caulking, bordered by perfectly smooth, glossy bright white fiberglass risers, curved stainless steel handrails, and a dark tinted glass window to the right. The midground opens up on the left half to thriving, choppy ocean water, leading into a deep background featuring a dominant {argument name="background" default="suspension bridge"} with tall towers and cables spanning from the top center to the top right, alongside a mid-right cityscape of buildings clustered on rolling coastal hills. The scene is bathed in a cheerful, breezy, and aspirational late afternoon atmosphere, driven by bright, highly directional warm golden sunlight beaming from the back-left. This single natural light source provides hard light with atmospheric diffusion, creating a split-complementary palette dominated by crisp whites, ocean blues, light beiges, and warm teak. Harsh, defined gray shadows are cast forward and to the right, prominently visible on the wooden steps beneath the subject, while softer shadows beautifully wrap across his body. Intense specular highlights blow out the water surface on the left and create a strong rim light along the yacht's left edges and stainless steel handrails. This tack sharp, grain-free digital lifestyle photograph captures a realistic, clean aesthetic shot from an eye-level perspective. Emulating a full-frame camera with a 35mm or 50mm lens at f/8, a 1/500s shutter speed, and ISO 100, the deep depth of field keeps both the subject and the distant bridge in crisp focus. Post-processing enhances the high contrast, lifts the shadows on the subject's front to compensate for the backlighting, and increases the overall golden warmth while preserving the specular water reflections, all seamlessly framed in a 3:4 aspect ratio.
